description: JUCE synths and effects units: realtime audio, the sound engines, the Dawn GPU painter, Stellix. Everything the kit installed before configurations existed.

replace.3: claude-packs (`@thedecipherist/claude-packs`) is the source of truth for every rule, check, hook and skill used to build synths. A fix to one of them, or a lesson that should hold in every synth, is made in the kit, with its test, and comes here with `npx --no-install @thedecipherist/claude-packs update`, so every synth gets it. A project edits its installed copy only to try a fix before it goes into the kit.
